bullets: On Wednesday 18 November, DLD recorded 410 sales valued at AED 1.2bn, which is 13.3% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 56.1% of sales on Wednesday, compared to a 7-day average of 59.7%.
The median price was AED 1,644 per sq ft, down 2.4% over 30 days and 5.4% compared to last year.
Over the past 7 days, the busiest areas for sales were JVC with 195, Business Bay with 139, and Saih Shuaib 1 with 129.
In October new rental contracts for a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median price of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: The Dubai Metro Blue Line is nearing thirty percent completion, which new transit infrastructure significantly boosts nearby property values and investor sentiment.
Aldar launched the NOMA creative hub and district in Abu Dhabi, which new master developments and community launches expand lifestyle offerings and shape regional supply and demand.
Stake and Rentify detailed proptech plans in Dubai, which innovations change how investors buy, finance, and manage real estate assets.
